personality_one_liner: An elegant, gallery-like experience that uses generous whitespace, premium typography, and warm neutrals to frame memories as high-end art.

spacing.rule: Generous magazine-like rhythms. Let content breathe. Strict adherence to safe-area bounds. Forms and text grouped logically with clear separation.

do's: Avoid glass entirely to maintain the matte, editorial, printed-art feel.
dont's: No blur on sticky headers or bottom sheets; rely on solid surfaceSecondary and thin border dividers.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Immerse the user in the luxury value proposition with gallery-like imagery and a clear call to action.
screens.layout: Full-bleed hero images using edge-to-edge layout. Text (serif display) overlaid at the bottom 40% with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) ensuring contrast. Sticky brandPrimary CTA button 'Create Your Art' at the bottom above safe-area.

screens.name: CameraAndUpload
screens.purpose: Capture or select a photo to begin the framing process.
screens.layout: Large upper viewfinder/preview area (70% height). Bottom section handles gallery picking: horizontally scrollable thumbnails. Minimal UI chrome—thin 1px dividers, flat icons.

screens.name: AIStyleSelection
screens.purpose: Apply AI artistic styles to the uploaded photo.
screens.layout: Top bar: Back, Title, Save. Main canvas dominates (large live preview). Bottom sheet: Horizontally scrollable thumbnails of style categories (Watercolor, Minimal, Luxury). Instant preview applied upon tap.

screens.name: Editor
screens.purpose: Adjust crop, print size, and physical frame choices.
screens.layout: Step-based layout. Live preview scales proportionally in the center. Bottom sheet expands for Frame picker (Wood, Metal, Acrylic) and Crop/Resize controls. A sticky 'Preview in Room' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: RoomPreview
screens.purpose: Visualize the framed artwork in realistic home environments.
screens.layout: Hero image of a living room wall with the generated framed art superimposed via drag/drop or pinch-to-zoom. Bottom row offers alternate room background thumbnails (living room, bedroom, hallway). Fixed sticky CTA 'Confirm Design'.

screens.name: ProductAndCheckout
screens.purpose: Review material, final pricing, and pay.
screens.layout: Editorial layout: Large final artwork image at the top. Generous vertical spacing. Pricing displayed in large serif font. Accordion sections for 'Materials' and 'Shipping'. Sticky full-width checkout button at the base.

screens.name: Gallery
screens.purpose: View past orders and saved art projects.
screens.layout: Masonry or 2-column grid. Generous padding around images. Images wrapped in subtle borders to mimic frames. Clean typographic headers.

screens.name: AdminDashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of recent orders, revenue, and uploads for store owners.
screens.layout: Text-heavy brutalist-leaning editorial list. Large serif numbers for metrics (Revenue, Orders). Simple list rows with order IDs and status tags using brandTertiary.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality. This app must feel like a premium, high-end gallery.
Do NOT use glassmorphism. The aesthetic relies on matte solid surfaces and distinct typographic hierarchy.
Ensure the Onboarding screen utilizes a full-bleed hero image with a correct 3-stop vertical gradient scrim to guarantee text contrast. Ensure CTA is pinned to the bottom.
Use Cormorant Garamond for display/headings and Satoshi for body. Maintain weight caps (max 500) and use size for hierarchy.
Implement the Editor/Mockup flow as a step-based layout using Bottom Sheets for tool selection (styles, frames, rooms).
Whenever creating an 'Empty' or 'Loading' state, ensure they fill the screen (flex: 1) appropriately.
For the Room Preview, use the provided room images and overlay the user's framed art in the center to simulate real-world scale.
